svg.title: Modeled time saved by better test repairs
svg.desc: Total modeled time saved rises from 0 percent at the 38.8 percent repair success rate to 9.7, 16.3, 21.6, 25.9, 29.4 and 32.4 percent at 50 to 100 percent success. Each ten-point step saves less: 9.7, 7.3, 6.3, 5.4, 4.8 and 4.2 percent compared with the preceding level.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #535e57

svg.text: Test repairs that pass all checks
